Asha (Design): quick sync — noticed some layout shift on the Console dashboard when the window width is between 880-980px. Card CTAs jump right when an overflow menu appears and toasts slide under the sticky nav. Noticed on Chrome + Safari. Screenshot in thread.
Tom L: Yup saw that too. The grid changes columns at 960px which makes the card width change and forces the action group to reflow.
Nina (A11y): A couple of accessibility things: 1) when the CTA moves, keyboard focus can end up outside the visible area; 2) toasts are announced inconsistently — sometimes silence then announced.
Asha (Design): My two proposals: (1) Keep breakpoint, but reduce horizontal gap token from `space-6` -> `space-5` at <=1000px so cards are slightly wider. (2) Keep gaps, but add reserved action width so overflow menu appears without pushing CTA. Which is less risky?
Ravi (Frontend): Option 1 is pretty safe — single CSS token swap at a media query. Option 2 requires careful layout changes and may cause truncation on long labels. Implementation snippet for option1: ```@media (max-width:1000px){ :root{ --space-horizontal: var(--space-5) } }```
Tom L: If we reserve width, maybe do `min-inline-size:84px` on `.card-actions` so CTA never shifts. But test with long action labels.
Nina (A11y): If we hide labels at smaller widths, ensure `aria-label` present and the tooltip includes the label text. Also ensure focus remains visible — we had a regression using 1px thin focus ring token. Use `--focus-thickness: 2px` and `--focus-color: var(--interactive-strong)`.
Asha (Design): Good call. I prefer swapping the gap token first (less surface area). If truncation still happens, fallback to reserved width + icon-only at <=720px.
Ravi (Frontend): Plan: I'll prototype token swap + toast offset change. Toasts currently have `top: var(--nav-height)` which clips when nav increases. I'll change to `top: calc(var(--nav-height) + var(--space-2))` and ensure toasts use role="status" aria-live="polite" so SRs get them.
Tom L: Also suggest making toast stacking stable: newest at top for errors, newest-bottom for neutral messages. Could do `data-level` attr.
Nina (A11y): For keyboard navigation, when the grid rearranges, we should maintain DOM order to avoid focus jumps. If we switch columns visually with CSS only, DOM stays stable.
Asha (Design): OK action list: 1) Ravi: token swap prototype + toast offset + role/aria-live (due EOD) 2) Asha: mocks showing reserved-action vs icon-only 3) Nina: run keyboard/screen-reader checks on prototype 4) Tom: test truncation cases.
design-bot: Created DR task: https://redwood.internal/tasks/DR-419 — assign reviewers when PR ready.
Ravi (Frontend): I'll add `aria-label` when hiding text and include shortcut in tooltip per Tom's previous note. Also will bump focus thickness.
Tom L: tiny microcopy thing: if an action becomes icon-only, tooltip should be full name + shortcut. e.g., "Export CSV — Shift+E"
Nina (A11y): Please verify that toasts with `aria-live` don't get read twice (some browsers read container + child). Use only container with role="status" and avoid double-announce.
Asha (Design): Great. Let's iterate on the prototype and reconvene. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
